05 — About
IT / Web Development Student

Hi, I'm
Jongwon.

I am a student at Purdue University — West Lafayette pursuing a Bachelor's in IT & Web Development.

I am a lifelong learner dedicated to utilizing cutting-edge technology to deliver scalable solutions and widespread impact. I’ve had the privilege of designing dynamic, evolving gameplay mechanics to architecting end-to-end IoT security systems.

I enjoy bridging software agility with hardware utility. My work includes a Raspberry Pi-powered surveillance platform featuring low-latency live streaming, intelligent motion alerts, and cloud-synchronized data storage.

When I’m not at the computer, I’m usually watching sports, trying out all kinds of foods, or exploring new places.
